Nini-4.cube: Nini, Danish North Sea: NODAB-97 3D final migration, box around Nini-4 and Nini-5

ext.about: Danish appraisal well of 2002 on the Nini West oil field, studied as a CO2 store in Project Greensand. Shown because it has what the open Norwegian wells in this app lack together: a shear sonic log, a vertical seismic profile and smectite measured on samples of the Eocene clay (the Horda Formation, pale greenish grey claystone in the operator's report). Vertical to within 13 m; measured depth and vertical depth differ by at most 0.2 m.
ext.logs: Free GEUS well package NINI-4 (merged wireline logs), GEUS terms for free Danish subsurface data

Nini-5.cube: Nini, Danish North Sea: NODAB-97 3D final migration, box around Nini-4 and Nini-5

ext.about: Danish appraisal well of 2007 on Nini East, 12 km north-east of Nini-4. It has a shear sonic log and a vertical seismic profile, but no smectite samples. The rock-mechanics tests published for this well (SINTEF 2009, GEUS file 35990) were made on Sele shale below the Horda Formation, not on the Horda clay. Vertical to within 6 m; measured depth and vertical depth differ by at most 0.3 m.
ext.logs: Free GEUS well package NINI-5 (merged wireline logs), GEUS terms for free Danish subsurface data
